clue.text: Presents itself an invitation to eat

parts.note: 'come!' is a call inviting someone along
to sup is to eat an evening meal

explanation.surface: Something turns up in the form of a dinner invitation.
explanation.definitionFit: When something arises or happens unexpectedly it is said to crop up in that way.

parts.note: not relocation but a home on wheels that travels with its owners

explanation.definitionFit: A towed mobile home is a dwelling that literally moves along the road.

clue.text: Squeezes every penny out of fish drink

parts.note: to milk someone is to exploit them for every penny
hake is a sea fish of the cod family

explanation.surface: A fishmonger profiteering from customers over a beverage.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick shake of milk blended with flavouring is a sweet cold beverage.

clue.text: In this way rob another kind of rubber

parts.note: 'so' means thus, in this way

indicators.note: another form of the word rob, i.e. its letters given a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: A thief steals a different sort of eraser.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' is the anagram signal: 'another kind of rob' gives a different arrangement of those three letters. Sorbo is a dated British brand of sponge rubber.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorbo is a trade name for a spongy springy rubber once used in balls and padding.

clue.text: 9 drug Cockney layer going to gallery

parts.note: pot is slang for cannabis
a hen lays eggs, and a Cockney drops the H: 'en
the Tate is the London art gallery

explanation.surface: An East End hen, drugged, wanders into an art gallery.
explanation.walkthrough: 9 points to the answer at 9 across, RULER. Cockney speech drops initial H.
explanation.definitionFit: A potentate is a monarch or sovereign with great power.

parts.note: Col is the abbreviation for colonel, an army officer
it's is short for it is

explanation.surface: An officer announces that something is a grievance.
explanation.definitionFit: Inflammation of the colon is a medical ailment, and 'complaint' means an illness.

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset means turned upside down, so the letters run backwards

parts.note: a/c, account, is a bill
thy is the archaic form of your

explanation.surface: A bill upsets a quaint young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Cathy is a female given name, short for Catherine.

parts.note: looks means one's appearance
a harp is a stringed musical instrument

explanation.surface: Advice to hurry, standing by a band instrument.
explanation.walkthrough: 'by' just places one piece next to the other.
explanation.definitionFit: To look sharp is an idiom meaning to hurry up, an order to make haste.

parts.note: the one word splits into bird, a tit, a small songbird, and man, he
the one word splits into bird, a tit, a small songbird, and man, he

explanation.surface: A levy on an aviator.
explanation.walkthrough: The single word 'birdman' has to be split into its two halves, each giving a piece; it is not an aviator.
explanation.definitionFit: A tithe was a tenth of produce paid as a levy to the church.

explanation.surface: Resolved to become settled.
explanation.definitionFit: A settled matter is decided or resolved, and a settled community has put down roots and is fixed in place.

explanation.surface: A manager who perhaps has two legs.
explanation.definitionFit: A head of state or chief governs others, and a measuring stick may be two feet long.

explanation.surface: An East End hat prompts revenge.
explanation.walkthrough: In Cockney rhyming slang 'tit for tat' means hat, because it rhymes.
explanation.definitionFit: Rhyming slang turns the phrase into a word for a hat, and the phrase also means paying back blow for blow.

parts.note: 6 in Roman numerals is VI, with the possessive s
a county is a region of administration

explanation.surface: The rank attached to the territory of the answer at 6.
explanation.walkthrough: '6' looks like a reference to another clue but is the Roman numeral VI.
explanation.definitionFit: A viscounty is the rank or dignity of a viscount, a noble title.

explanation.surface: Categorise a projectile.
explanation.walkthrough: The Shell is the name of a form or class in some British public schools.
explanation.definitionFit: Some English schools name an intermediate form the Shell, and an artillery projectile fired from a gun is a shell.

clue.text: Where some Welsh live down under

explanation.surface: A place in Wales described as being in Australia.
explanation.walkthrough: Neath is a town in South Wales; 'down under' suggests Australia but just means below.
explanation.definitionFit: Neath is a town in South Wales, and the poetic contraction of beneath means below.

explanation.surface: Someone lacking emotion who has been dismissed in court.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nonsuited' reads as a legal term but here means lacking one suit of cards, hearts.
explanation.definitionFit: A cruel person lacks compassion, and a bridge hand void in one suit holds no hearts.

clue.text: Pop round with piano taken up and valued

indicators.note: turned round, so the word for father reads backwards

parts.note: pa is a familiar name for father, like pop
p is the musical abbreviation for piano, softly
raised means lifted, taken up

explanation.surface: Dad goes round with a piano that is lifted and priced.
explanation.definitionFit: Something appraised has been assessed and given a price.

explanation.surface: Instructions on how to cast a ballot.
explanation.walkthrough: On a British ballot paper the voter marks a cross by the chosen name.
explanation.definitionFit: To put something across is to communicate it clearly, and a voter literally marks a cross.

clue.text: Odds on frigidity having a certain piquancy

indicators.note: in a down clue, one piece sits on top of the other

parts.note: SP, starting price, gives the odds in horse racing
iciness means extreme coldness

explanation.surface: Betting on coldness gives a certain bite.
explanation.definitionFit: Piquancy is a sharp savoury taste, the quality of being spicy and hot.

parts.note: pre means before
VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
to lend is to advance money, so advanced is lent

explanation.surface: Ordinary before a loan to an American state.
explanation.definitionFit: Something prevalent is widespread and usual.

clue.text: Friend has a row with knight-errant

parts.note: a pal is a friend
din is a noisy row, a racket

explanation.surface: A mate quarrels with a wandering knight.
explanation.definitionFit: Paladins were Charlemagne's champions, and the word means a chivalrous heroic knight.

indicators.note: the word for multi-coloured is placed outside, around, the abbreviation for left

parts.note: pied means of two or more colours, patchy

explanation.surface: A patchwork-clad outside-left footballer rehearsed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'outside left' looks like a football position, but 'outside' is the container signal and 'left' gives L.
explanation.definitionFit: To ply a trade is to work at it regularly, so plied means practised.

explanation.surface: A theatre helper who also treats injuries.
explanation.definitionFit: A theatrical helper who assists actors with costumes, and one who bandages and treats wounds.

clue.text: Pound and a quarter at the minimum

parts.note: L is the abbreviation for pound, from Latin libra
east is one of the four compass quarters

explanation.surface: Weighing a pound and a quarter at the very least.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pound and a quarter' reads as a weight, 1.25 lb, but splits into two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Least means the smallest amount, the lowest quantity.

clue.text: Mums sex-appeal turns up in India

indicators.note: in a down clue the whole run is turned upward, read backwards

parts.note: mas are mothers, mums
SA is the abbreviation for sex appeal

explanation.surface: Mothers' allure turns up in India.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turns up' reverses the whole MASSA to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Assam is a state of north-east India famous for tea, so it is a region found in India.

parts.note: to second a motion is to support, or back, it
a slide is playground equipment for children

explanation.surface: Another children's toy prompts a lapse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Second' looks like a unit of time but means to support.
explanation.definitionFit: To backslide is to slip back into bad old ways, to fall back into error.

explanation.surface: A part of the orchestra earns cash.
explanation.definitionFit: The trumpets and trombones make up one section of an orchestra, and in slang it also means cash.

clue.text: South African car firm on point of producing fur

indicators.note: in a down clue the earlier pieces stand on top of the later one

parts.note: BL was British Leyland, the former British car maker
E, east, is a point of the compass

explanation.surface: A South African car maker about to produce fur coats.
explanation.walkthrough: British Leyland, BL, was a big British carmaker of the 1970s.
explanation.definitionFit: Sable is the dark pelt of a small Asian marten, a prized fur.

clue.text: Speed spoiled right fuss made by ruffian

indicators.note: speed that is spoiled is ruined, its letters thrown into disorder

parts.note: ado means fuss or bother

explanation.surface: Haste ruined the right fuss caused by a thug.
explanation.definitionFit: A desperado is a reckless outlaw or bandit.

clue.text: Adore going second-class on the French boat

parts.note: B is the grade for second class
le is French for the
SS stands for steamship, a boat

explanation.surface: A worshipper travelling second-class on a French vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: To bless is to praise or glorify, as in worship.

clue.text: Final retribution is seen to involve about 1000

indicators.note: to involve something is to take it inside, so the reversed word holds the numeral
about means turned around, so the word seen runs backwards

parts.note: M is the Roman numeral for 1000

explanation.surface: The final punishment for a crime is seen to come in about a thousand ways.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' is the reversal signal and 'to involve' the container signal, holding the Roman thousand; 'is' joins at the end although it comes first in the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Nemesis brought just punishment, and the word means retribution that cannot be escaped.

indicators.note: sounding means the word must be said, not seen, to match

parts.note: a spencer is a short woollen jacket or vest

explanation.surface: A poet who sounds fuzzy.
explanation.walkthrough: Edmund Spenser wrote The Faerie Queene.
explanation.definitionFit: Edmund Spenser was the Elizabethan author of The Faerie Queene.
